NOUGHTVAULT  //  FOUNDATIONS · TYPE

Type

Two faces doing opposite jobs. A monospace carries every piece of structural chrome — mastheads, section labels, captions, dimensions, tables — so anything that is machinery looks like machinery. A Palatino-class serif carries the prose, warm against the cold accent. No webfonts anywhere: the pages are read behind a strict CSP, and a silent fallback would be worse than a system stack chosen on purpose.
